method: Built-in image_gen; five independent generation calls, 16 November 2026
usage: Original outputs retained. Grayscale luminance interpreted as density by study renderer; black is clear sky, not displayed black pigment.

prompts.name: cumulus
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: high-resolution cloud density texture for wrapping onto a 3D planet in a game. Generate a single wide 2:1 rectangular full-frame flat overhead satellite-style cloud-only map, ideally 2048x1024 or larger. Monochrome white clouds on pure black empty gaps; black means clear sky, white means opaque cloud cores, gray only for cloud edge/density detail. No land, no ocean, no globe, no horizon, no atmosphere rim, no blue, no text, no borders. Orthographic top-down, no perspective. Even neutral illumination with NO directional shadows or baked day/night shading. Real Earth meteorological structures, crisp multiscale detail and coherent large formations, avoid uniform blurry noise. Across the map retain about 50% clear black openings; include substantial truly white opaque cores, finely structured feathered edges. Make left and right edges naturally wrap continuously; this is a longitude-latitude map not a photo of a sphere. Broken cumulus fields: clusters of small rounded cottonlike cells arranged into larger irregular banks, broad clear channels, discernible individual cloud tops and delicate broken margins.
